baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ joins a judgment to an emphatically negated future of حور.
baseline_models.mechanism: A belief formed from an indication freezes the present as terminal: no return, decrease after increase, wavering, or change of state can reopen it.

activation_trace.role: Its literal certainty after an indication supplies the subject's conversion of an inference into closure.
Its literal turning back, decrease, and state-change define the motions that the negation excludes.

changed_reading.before: He thought he would not come back.
changed_reading.after: He treated an indicated expectation as certainty that his present condition had no reverse movement, diminution, or reopening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ظَنَّ governs the forecast أَن لَّن يَحُورَ, so the quality of the forecast is itself exposed.
baseline_models.mechanism: ظن can name weak supposition or a matter whose outcome cannot be trusted, while أَن لَّن seals that unstable forecast as absolute. The sentence can therefore stage epistemic overreach rather than mere ignorance.

activation_trace.role: Its literal doubt or imagining supplies the weak evidential base beneath the absolute prediction.
Its literal unreliable outcome makes the predicted future precisely the kind of end that cannot safely be closed.
Its literal wavering and change give the forecast a live alternative that لَن suppresses.

changed_reading.before: His belief was simply factually mistaken.
changed_reading.after: He made an intrinsically uncertain outcome sound irreversible, revealing the mechanism of his mistake inside the sentence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus verb يَحُورَ also carries branches of returned speech and rotation around an axis.
baseline_models.mechanism: The expected horizon is treated as a fixed position from which no reply, counter-turn, or answering movement will come back to unsettle the subject.

activation_trace.role: Its literal expected place or sign supplies the familiar horizon that the subject mistakes for the whole field.
Its literal turning of speech back and forth supplies a denied answer or counter-speech.
Its literal axial turning supplies the denied counter-turn while keeping the reading exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The negation concerns only travel back to an origin.
changed_reading.after: The negation may also imagine a fixed horizon with no answering or rotational counter-movement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sky opens; sky and earth receive and accept command; earth casts out its contents and becomes vacant. Nonreturn now reads as a denied unsealing: the subject imagines himself exempt from the world-scale reversal, exposure, and discharge around him.

activation_trace.role: Its literal reversal and state-change anchor the focus denial that the cosmic sequence contests.
Its literal splitting and opening initiate the mechanism of a closed order being breached.
Its literal listening and acceptance make the sky responsive rather than self-enclosed.
The repeated literal listening and acceptance extend the same responsiveness to the earth.
Its literal binding due-ness makes transformation an owed necessity, not an accident.
Its literal casting supplies the outward transfer of what had been held inside.
Its literal vacancy completes the image of a container emptied by reversal.

structural_cues: The opening alternates sky and earth under conditional إذا, repeats وأذنت لربها وحقت, and places expulsion before vacancy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, acceptance, necessity, casting, and vacancy; I infer that the person is analogized to a closed container expecting not to be reopened or discharged. A live alternative is that these are only cosmic preliminaries without a direct anthropological transfer.

changed_reading.after: He expected his enclosed condition never to be opened, reversed, or made to yield what it contained, although the surrounding world does exactly that.

context_deltas.mechanism: The human's labor is directed toward the Lord and terminates in encounter. Return is therefore not retracing a path but a one-way expenditure that converges on meeting and completion.

activation_trace.role: Its literal return and change anchor the denied terminus of the directed movement.
Its literal strenuous labor supplies the irreversible expenditure along the path.
Its literal convergence of two facing things supplies the encounter toward which the labor moves.
Its literal nurture, repair, and completion make the Lord the completing terminus rather than merely a location.

structural_cues: إلى ربك ... فملاقيه gives an explicit direction followed by a resultative encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies toil, direction, and meeting; I infer that expenditure cannot remain open-ended and must converge. The pronoun in ملاقيه may point immediately to the toil or to the Lord, but either live alternative preserves eventual encounter with what the path has produced.

changed_reading.before: Return would require choosing to travel backward.
changed_reading.after: The supposed nonreturn is impossible because forward striving itself accumulates into an encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the record and reckoning, one person dynamically turns to his people rejoicing; the focus subject had statically been among his people rejoicing. The repeated social destination and affect relocate joy from a prior enclosure to a post-accounting arrival, exposing his mistake as projection of household continuity.

activation_trace.role: Its literal return and change anchor the reversal between past enclosure and future arrival.
Its literal binding record supplies the adjudicative threshold before the successful return.
Its literal counting and accounting supply the process through which return is reached.
Its literal opening into ease after difficulty supplies the transition preceding joyful arrival.
Its literal turning, departure, and destination provide the explicit contextual counterpart to يحور.
Its literal group of kin and belonging supplies the destination of the successful turn.
Its literal inward joy and ease mark the affect carried after that turn.
Its literal state occurring in time fixes the focus subject's joy in a prior temporal condition.
The repeated literal kin-group turns the same household image into a before-and-after mirror.
The repeated literal inward joy marks the affect he wrongly extrapolates beyond its prior setting.

structural_cues: Verses 9 and 13 repeat أهله مسرورا but contrast dynamic وينقلب إلى with static كان في.
The focus follows the failed portrait immediately, making his nonreturn belief the causal explanation of that contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact household-and-joy mirror plus opposed motion and stativity; I infer that prior domestic ease became the evidence for imagined permanence. A live alternative is that the repetition only contrasts two outcomes, without diagnosing the social source of his belief.

changed_reading.before: He denied a generic return after death.
changed_reading.after: He mistook being happily enclosed among his people for a condition that could never reverse, while the counterpart receives joy only after turning through account.

context_deltas.mechanism: A binding record arrives behind the back, where concealment and the reversal of outside and inside meet; the recipient then calls ruin. What he expected not to come back can be read as concealed consequence returning into encounter, with his own cry becoming the counter-speech he had excluded.

activation_trace.role: Its literal expected place supplies the behind-the-back horizon in which consequence was presumed to remain.
Its literal returned speech supplies the denied counter-speech that later emerges as a cry.
Its literal record that establishes a binding judgment supplies the consequence that cannot remain inert.
Its literal concealment behind visibility supplies the attempted location of excluded consequence.
Its literal turning an affair from back to belly supplies the exposure of what had been reversed out of sight.
Its literal vocal call supplies the speech that breaks the subject's imagined silence.
Its literal ruin gives the returned cry the consequence named by the hidden record.

structural_cues: The failed branch moves from a record behind the back to a voiced call of ruin before the explanation of his former joy and belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding record, concealment, back-facing reversal, and a later cry; I infer a return of excluded consequence and a speech-counterturn. A live alternative is that وراء ظهره describes only delivery posture and that the cry is not an answer to anything.

changed_reading.after: No hidden record, consequence, or answering word would be turned back into his field, an expectation undone by the record and his own cry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The corrective بلى places the subject's inward forecast against the Lord's continuous sight. His error is not merely missing information; it is treating a first-person evidential horizon as total while a superior witness already encompasses him.

activation_trace.role: Its literal certainty after an indication supplies the bounded self-certainty corrected by a fuller witness.
Its literal weak supposition remains the live diagnosis once the external witness is introduced.
Its literal lordship and ownership identify the witness whose horizon exceeds the subject's.
Its literal presence through time supplies continuity to the Lord's seeing rather than a late discovery.
Its literal visual perception supplies direct observation against the subject's forecast.
Its literal insight of the heart supplies penetration beyond outward conduct into the belief itself.

structural_cues: بلى directly reverses لن, and the following clause contrasts his ظن with the Lord's كان به بصيرا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct correction and continuous sight; I infer an asymmetry between self-estimation and encompassing observation. The simpler live alternative is that sight only warrants the ordinary assertion of resurrection without characterizing how his belief formed.

changed_reading.after: His forecast absolutized a private horizon already enclosed by an uninterrupted observer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Twilight yields to night; night gathers; the moon reaches completion; the human rides state after state. This sequence activates حور as axial turning and alteration, making nonreturn a denial of the phase-law shared by sky, time, and person.

activation_trace.role: Its literal turning on an axis supplies the rotational mechanism latent in the celestial sequence.
Its literal change from one state to another transfers phase-turning from cosmos to person.
Its literal sunset redness supplies the visible threshold between phases.
Its literal darkness opposed to day supplies the succeeding phase after twilight.
Its literal gathering of dispersed things makes night an accumulating transition rather than empty darkness.
Its literal moon and celestial light supply the rotating body's visible phase.
Its literal completion and even ordering supply the moon's achieved fullness within a cycle.
Its literal superposition of one thing on another supplies the human mounting of successive conditions.
Its literal state after state names the serial human transformation that completes the analogy.

structural_cues: The oath sequence advances from a transitional color to gathering darkness, a completed moon, and emphatic human passage through successive states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered celestial phases and explicit human state succession; I infer a shared law of turning and transfer. A live alternative is linear stage progression rather than cyclical return, so the model retains both axial recurrence and cumulative metamorphosis.

changed_reading.before: Return means only going back to a prior place.
changed_reading.after: Return is phase-turning itself: the person cannot remain fixed because he is carried through ordered states as surely as twilight, night, and moon change.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence moves from absent trust, through heard recitation and refused lowering, to covering, denial, and inward storage known by God. ظن is no longer a detached proposition; it becomes a self-sealing interior stance enacted by the body.

activation_trace.role: Its literal uncertain supposition supplies the thought that hardens into a defensive posture.
Its literal heart-settling assent supplies the trust withheld by the subject's closed forecast.
Its literal recitation supplies an external address that reaches the deniers before their embodied refusal.
Its literal lowering and submission supply the bodily counter-movement they refuse to make.
Its literal covering of truth supplies the sealing action that protects the forecast from correction.
Its literal attribution of falsehood supplies the outward speech-act that maintains the denial.
Its literal disclosure to a knower supplies penetration of the stance despite its concealment.
Its literal holding of meaning in the heart supplies the interior container where denial is accumulated.

structural_cues: Question, recitation, refusal to prostrate, denial, and divine knowledge form a progression from claim to body to concealed interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withheld assent, an addressed recitation, bodily non-submission, covering, denial, and inward containment; I infer that the focus belief is maintained behaviorally and affectively. A live alternative is that these later verses describe a wider group rather than the singular subject's psychology.

changed_reading.before: He held an incorrect opinion about the future.
changed_reading.after: He stored and enacted nonreturn as a protective stance, covering counterevidence and refusing the body's own downward counter-turn.

context_deltas.mechanism: حور includes decrease after increase, while the final reward is explicitly marked as not cut or diminished. The subject's belief can therefore be heard as a misallocation of permanence: he grants non-recession to his current ease, while the text grants uncut continuity elsewhere.

activation_trace.role: Its literal certainty after an indication supplies the confident but wrongly allocated claim of permanence.
Its literal decrease after increase supplies the recession that the subject denies for his own condition.
Its literal recompense for work identifies the outcome to which enduring continuity is actually attached.
Its literal negation and exception supply the explicit exclusion of cutoff from the reward.
Its literal cutting and diminution until extension ends supply the cessation negated in the final phrase.

structural_cues: The closing exception assigns غير ممنون to reward after faith and fitting action, not to the earlier household ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decrease within حور and an explicitly non-diminishing reward; I infer a contrast over who or what truly receives permanence. A live alternative is that the final phrase only describes reward duration and does not echo the subject's denial.

changed_reading.before: He believed he would not return from his present life.
changed_reading.after: He believed his present increase would never recede, but the ending reallocates genuine non-cessation to recompense rather than to his domestic ease.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant وسم mapping carried by the context root س م و rather than substituting it for the ordinary word السماء. It remains valid as a structural activation of ظن's indication branch, sharpened by the sky's visible rupture. Render it only as a resonance about misread signs, never as the lexical meaning of السماء.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ظَنَّ is anchored in the focus through its branch of certainty formed after an indication.

activation_trace.role: Its literal certainty after an indication supplies the focus question of how a sign became a conclusion.
Its literal visible mark indicating a condition activates the sky as a publicly readable sign-field.
Its literal rupture and opening make that sign-field visibly contradict terminal closure.

changed_reading.before: He lacked a sign of return.
changed_reading.after: He may have built certainty by misreading a marked world whose very visible rupture announces that closed conditions can open.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates حور's dialogue and returned-reply branch inside a verb normally read as physical return. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and gains a sequence from creation listening twice to the failed subject later calling ruin. Render it as a secondary speech-mechanism, not as a replacement translation of يحور.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يَحُورَ is the focus verb, and its branch inventory explicitly includes speech turned back and forth, answer, and reply.

activation_trace.role: Its literal mutual speech and returned reply supply the odd but exact focus activation.
Its literal listening and acceptance supply one side of a responsive creation.
Its repeated literal listening makes responsiveness a structural refrain rather than an isolated image.
Its literal vocal summons supplies the subject's eventual entry into the speech circuit.
Its literal ruin supplies the content of the cry that answers his earlier closure.

changed_reading.before: He thought no one would physically return.
changed_reading.after: He also behaved as though no answer would come back, while responsive creation and his own later cry place him inside an answering exchange.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the ruin and stagnation branch of حور rather than its dominant return branch. It remains anchored in يَحُورَ and is externally activated by the immediate cry of ruin and entry into kindled fire. Render it as an ironic undertone of imagined immunity from collapse, not as the primary lexical parsing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated focus verb يَحُورَ carries a branch of ruin and stagnation alongside return.

activation_trace.role: Its literal certainty after an indication supplies the subject's confidence in immunity.
Its literal ruin and stagnation supply the denied collapse within the exact focus root.
Its literal ruin externalizes the collapse that the exploratory focus branch hears as denied.
Its literal encounter with fire gives the collapse a bodily consequence.
Its literal kindling of fire supplies the active environment of the denied ruin.

changed_reading.before: He expected not to return after death.
changed_reading.after: He also imagined that the happy enclosure around him would never collapse into ruin or arrested loss, precisely the outcome the sequence then names.

strongest_changes: The exact أهله مسرورا mirror changed generic nonreturn into projection of prior household joy, contrasted with joy reached only after account and turning.
The opening unsealing and the later twilight-night-moon-state sequence changed return from simple backward travel into a world-law of exposure and phased transformation.
The faith-recitation-prostration-covering-storage sequence changed ظن from a detached opinion into an inwardly stored and bodily enacted refusal.
The closing غير ممنون changed non-decrease into a contested allocation of permanence rather than a neutral description of duration.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots sustained several mechanisms without collapse into one verdict: حور remained return, decrease, reply, axial turning, and exploratory ruin, while ظن ranged from sign-based certainty to unstable supposition. Context made those branches causal through household mirroring, cosmic responsiveness, directed labor, hidden accounting, continuous sight, and ordered phases.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the dialogue branch of حور should remain only a resonance or can support a fuller answering-exchange reading.
Whether the non-dominant وسم activation under س م و illuminates sign-reading enough to survive beyond outlier status.
Whether ملاقيه points immediately to the toil or to the Lord; both preserve convergence but color the mechanism differently.
Whether state after state is primarily cyclical return, linear accumulation, or deliberately permits both.
